metadata.title: Al/Mg/Ti/Ta/Zr structural neighbors: 250,000 training anchors
metadata.description: Frozen five-metal positions-only structural pretraining release: 250,000 training anchor records and 480 Al selection records. Dynamic observations include three causal frames, a separate next-frame target and a nearby-center view. Per-material fixed cutoff normalization, geometry85, and masked instantaneous TDA144. Plan records every native/shooting ancestry, source manifest, target producer, calibrated radius and extraction task.
limitations: Static Al/Mg/Ta/Zr generating potentials are not established; their batches carry unknown-static provenance.
Anchor records and shooting descendants are correlated; counts are not independent sources. Only the native Al cohort provides independent selection/test roles.
No velocities or relaxed-TDA targets. Irregular saved-frame intervals retain their measured physical time offsets.
The immutable plan contains the full native/shooting source lineage inventory beyond the top-level collection dependencies.

metadata.title: Fourfold dynamic structural expansion: 1,018,080 Al/Mg/Ti/Ta anchors
metadata.description: Adds 763,560 dynamic anchors at previously unused source/frame combinations across all six training strata. Sampling balances ancestral lineages, then trajectories subject to unused-frame capacity. Retains all parent shards, the 480 selection anchors and fixed material scales. The dynamic-only training subset has 1,018,080 anchors; inherited static data (including Zr) is excluded by the training protocol. Instantaneous TDA144 covers every supervised anchor/spatial/future view; new shards use the local 8-normalized-unit support. No new simulations.
limitations: Static Al/Mg/Ta/Zr generating potentials are not established; their batches carry unknown-static provenance.
Anchor records and shooting descendants are correlated; counts are not independent sources. Only the native Al cohort provides independent selection/test roles.
No velocities or relaxed-TDA targets. Irregular saved-frame intervals retain their measured physical time offsets.

metadata.title: Dense local onset transfer: 150 Al sources, 362400 candidate windows
metadata.description: Existing 150 independent 70304-atom Al runs at 400–520 K; 16 outcome-independent tracked centers, 3 ps origins, fixed 90/15/15/30 lineage split. Local MACE graphs and native scalar/tensor features at sparse historical times and seven geometric context centers. Cached verified PTM labels from the local-predictability assay. No simulations generated.
limitations: Candidate windows are correlated; independent sample unit is source lineage. At-risk filtering reduces the candidate count.
Sparse history snapshots and seven representative context centers, not dense spacetime observations.
Positions enter MACE; the separate physical descriptor baseline additionally uses existing velocities. No relaxed-TDA targets.

metadata.title: Tracked six-neighbor space-time JEPA: 65,536 mixed-material training anchors
metadata.description: Current-frame angular-coverage neighbor selection; same seven atom identities at previous/current/next saved frames. Local radius-8 complete graphs. Current/next center physical85 and instantaneous TDA144 are inherited from the full-TDA parent. 480 native-Al selection anchors remain held out. No static data, velocities, relaxed targets or new simulations.
limitations: Selection is native Al only; anchor and shooting counts are not independent trajectories.
Physical time gaps depend on the recorded source cadence.
Only center current/next views have fixed physical/TDA labels; neighbor targets are learned equivariant/invariant embeddings.
Six neighbors provide approximate angular coverage, not an exact canonical cubic frame.

metadata.title: Neighborhood JEPA v2 native Al, fixed 0.75 ps lag and smooth anchored moments
metadata.description: 8,995 training anchors in 36 independent native lineages and 480 selection anchors in 15 lineages. Inherited checked radius8 graphs and physical85/TDA144 labels. New degree1/2/4/6 multiscale C2 moments, training-only per-block scales. Known temperature conditions. No simulations added.
limitations: Selection previously used in encoder development.
Inherited float16 coordinate quantization; float32 graph storage does not recover precision.
TDA nearest80 membership remains a separate nonsmooth target; no relaxed TDA.

metadata.title: Expanded native Al JEPA 32,768 anchors: graphs
metadata.description: 32,768 source-balanced training anchors from 90 native Al lineages, plus the same 480 selection anchors from 15 held-out lineages. Existing Lee 2003 MEAM dynamics, fixed 0.75 ps lag. Physical85 and instantaneous TDA144 labels; 21 tracked atom-centered views. V2 adds fixed smooth multiscale angular moments. No new simulation.
limitations: Selection previously used in encoder development.
Inherited float16 coordinate quantization; float32 graph storage does not recover precision.

metadata.title: Native Al 32768 order anchors and frozen random MACE reservoir
metadata.description: Derived current/next local order targets and unlabeled fixed random geometric features on the existing 32768 training / 480 development anchor release; 90/15 independent Lee-MEAM lineages, 0.75 ps lag. No new simulations.

provenance.normalization: training-only current and next center targets, per-component std floor 1e-4
provenance.reservoir: Random width16 MACE, seed9173, orthogonal 128-to-64 projection, no labels or learned parent weights

limitations: Order neighbors restricted to encoder-observed local crop; not guaranteed identical to full-trajectory handcrafted baseline neighborhoods.
One random reservoir initialization.
No new independent test cohort.

metadata.title: Native Al tracked future-center graphs at 3, 6, 9 ps
metadata.description: Future local graph teacher targets for joint invariant/equivariant JEPA prediction on the existing 32768/480 anchor split; 97328 valid training and 1440 validation future observations.

provenance.ancestry: Same 90 training and 15 development native-Al independent roots; no calibration/test roots
provenance.raw_precision: Inherited float16 positions, reconstructed float32 local graphs; no precision recovery
provenance.targets: Physical85 and instantaneous TDA144 use existing physical-coordinate producers; train-only inherited normalizers; future embedding targets computed online by joint encoder

limitations: Late trajectory origins have no 6/9 ps follow-up and are explicitly masked.
Only the tracked center is added at long horizons; six spatial-neighbor tasks retain their existing current/.75 ps lags.
One seed; no new independent test cohort.

metadata.title: Equivariant spatial-context Al feature cache
metadata.description: Frozen shared-MACE scalar/tensor feature cache at 25 patches for 31,609 prospective windows across 150 independent Al sources. Observed and same-frame relaxed inputs; extraction follows fresh likelihood-trained width-128 encoders. Node59 batch/microbatch 512 queue authorized on 2026-09-25.
limitations: Not generated yet.
Historical test sources reused.
Box-fixed query stencil and hard nearest-80 membership are not globally rotation-invariant under resampling.
Inherited float16 absolute-coordinate quantization; no new simulation or quench.

metadata.title: Confirmed crystal distances for dynamic multi-material MACE training
metadata.description: 12,747,736 training and 192,000 Al selection neighborhoods; existing dynamic structural centers at multiple timesteps, excluding initial unconfirmed history. Labels only; coordinates reused from the sealed structural release.
metadata.lineage: Frozen native Al 90/15 train/selection ancestry; external branches train-only with their recorded shared preparation groups. No new simulation.
limitations: External branches are not independent replicates; no external-material validation/test claim.
Distances and inputs use fixed Al-reference length normalization; no material/temperature/time input.
Targets refer to already confirmed crystal components, not future nucleation.

metadata.title: Tracked-atom MD histories for unchanged crystal-front evaluation
metadata.lineage: Original fixed Al64 selection/calibration/test source roles; no source resplitting.
metadata.description: Geometry at -6/-3/0 ps for every original held-out fixed observation and controlled scan-position atom. Same atom ID followed through MD; no new simulation.
limitations: Al held-out evaluation only; external material generalization is not evaluated.
History visibility includes all observed MD frames; not interchangeable with snapshot visibility.

metadata.title: Withdrawn mixed-cadence six-frame geometry preparation
metadata.description: Withdrawn before any GPU training after the user required uniform physical observation spacing. Preparation also encountered IDS quota. Frozen preparation receipts are preserved; disposable geometry may be reused or removed.
metadata.lineage: Inherited fixed Al64 source roles; external branches train-only with their original shared ancestry. No new simulation.
limitations: Cadence is .75 ps on native Al, .10 ps on external training sources; no cadence value is a model input.
Held-out performance is evaluated on Al only.

metadata.title: Six closest MD frames for crystal distance: evaluation
metadata.description: Six preceding/current local MD observations for unchanged fixed Al64 held-out rows and spatial scan-position atoms. Float32 relative coordinates, reused from existing trajectories without additional quantization.
metadata.lineage: Unchanged fixed Al64 selection/calibration/test source roles and spatial scan-position atoms.
limitations: All observations have uniform 0.75-ps cadence.
Held-out performance is Al only.

metadata.title: Unsubmitted native-only six-frame candidate
metadata.description: Shared float32 geometry bank for six tracked-atom observations, 0.75 ps apart in every source. 4,561,920 training and 190,080 selection windows; no new simulation.
metadata.lineage: Fixed Al64 native source roles: 90 train, 15 selection. No external trajectory ancestry included. Anchor rows match the native subset of the wider-history arm.
limitations: Al only; external sources with 0.10-ps cadence excluded.
The wider-history arm includes external training sources, so comparing it directly cannot isolate sampling cadence.
Superseded by the user-approved all-data nominal .75/.70-ps experiment before training.

metadata.title: Six-frame nominal 0.75-ps all-data distance training
metadata.description: 11,375,472 train and 190,080 selection windows. Native exact .75 ps; external exact .70 ps, explicitly accepted as nominal .75 ps. No interpolation.
metadata.lineage: Fixed native Al roles unchanged; all external ancestry stays train-only.
limitations: Nominal cadence is not a claim of identical physical intervals: actual native/external spans are 3.75/3.50 ps.

metadata.title: Six-frame exact 0.10-ps external distance study
metadata.description: 3,374,496 train, 377,496 selection and 3,061,560 test windows, all at .10-ps intervals and .50-ps span; no interpolation.
metadata.lineage: Train Al-million/Mg/Ti families; selection Al archive; test Ta archive. Entire ancestry groups stay together. This is a separate external assay, not a change to Al64 roles.
limitations: Selection/test each have one ancestry family; test is also transfer to unseen Ta.
Not directly comparable to fixed-Al spatial-path warning metrics.

metadata.title: Ta known-parent shooting distance evaluation
metadata.description: Four completed 1,024,000-atom branches; shot00 selection, shots01-03 test. 10,240 tracked centers, six 0.70-ps observations, six anchors per branch.
metadata.ancestry: One archived Ta preparation; parent encoder saw a different trajectory from the same initial structure.
limitations: Conditional new-velocity evaluation, not independent-preparation generalization.
Parent was already trained on all six older Ta trajectories.
